anomalies.observed: SW6.1 and SW6.2 are on Net-(R34-Pad2) and Net-(R35-Pad2) respectively; SW6.3 and SW6.4 are on /CAN1_P and /CAN0_P. For a 2x SPST DIP switch, pins 1-2 and 3-4 are the switch pairs, so closing switch 1 connects R34.2 to R35.2, and closing switch 2 connects /CAN1_P to /CAN0_P.
anomalies.expected: R34 should terminate CAN0 between /CAN0_N and /CAN0_P, and R35 should terminate CAN1 between /CAN1_N and /CAN1_P. The switches should connect R34.2 to /CAN0_P and R35.2 to /CAN1_P, not to each other or across buses.
anomalies.impact: Closing SW6.2 shorts CAN0_P and CAN1_P, merging the two isolated CAN buses. Closing SW6.1 puts the two 120R resistors in series between CAN0_N and CAN1_N, providing no termination. This would disrupt CAN communication.

anomalies.observed: The net /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW contains only D14.2, D23.2, and D4.2. It is not connected to any power rail or switch.
anomalies.expected: The anodes of these LEDs should be connected to a 3.3V supply (e.g., +3V3) or a switched 3.3V rail so they can illuminate when their cathodes are pulled low.
anomalies.impact: D14, D23, and D4 will never light because their anodes are floating.

anomalies.observed: R60.2 is on ESTOP_OUT, and R60.1 is on Net-(D30-K2) with D30.2. D30.4 (A2) is also on ESTOP_OUT. Thus R60 is in parallel with the D30 LED2 between ESTOP_OUT and Net-(D30-K2), with no connection to ground.
anomalies.expected: R60 should connect D30.2 (K2) to GND, so that LED2 illuminates when ESTOP_OUT is high.

evidence.quote: ESTOP_OUT : D30.4(A2,input) J13.6(Pin_6,passive) J2.6(Pin_6,passive) R60.2(passive) U36.4(Y,output)

anomalies.impact: The second LED in D30 (likely the e-stop indicator) will never light because it is shorted by R60 and has no ground return.

parsed.summary: The design files contain multiple anomalies. The most severe is the CAN termination switch SW6, which is wired to short CAN0_P to CAN1_P and to put the two termination resistors in series between the CAN_N lines, rather than providing proper per-bus termination. Additionally, the anodes of D14, D23, and D4 are left floating on /LED_3.3V_POWER_SW, and the e-stop indicator LED D30 has its current-limiting resistor R60 connected to ESTOP_OUT instead of ground, preventing it from lighting.
